heatmap.calibrating: Pace colours will appear once Tapomo finishes calibrating.
apps.title: By application
settings.title: Settings
settings.pause.hint: If you stop typing for longer than this, the burst ends and the pause isn't counted.
settings.fullscreen.hint: Games and presentations are not measured.

about.title: About
about.privacy: Tapomo never stores what you type: it only counts keystrokes and timings.
about.privacy_passwords: Password fields are ignored entirely: not counted, not timed.
live.title: Right now
live.idle: Type and watch your pace live
live.calibrating: Calibrating… Keep typing so Tapomo learns your normal pace ({have}/{need} long bursts)
settings.show_pet.hint: A small floating Tapomo that reacts as you type. It never takes focus, clicks go through it except over Tapomo itself, and it hides during fullscreen apps. Drag it to move it.
settings.logs.hint: Log files with Tapomo's warnings and errors. They never contain what you type or which keys you press.
tip.avg: Words per minute (1 word = 5 characters), only while you type continuously: pauses longer than {pause} s don't count. "Net" also subtracts what you delete.
tip.peak: Your highest speed held for 10 seconds in a row.
tip.best: Characters in a row without pressing delete (your best no-backspace streak). It is kept even if you pause.
tip.current: Characters you have typed in a row right now without pressing delete. Back to zero when you delete.
tip.time: Real time spent typing: the sum of your bursts, without the pauses.
tip.chars: Number of characters typed in this period. They are only counted: which characters they are is never stored.
tip.heatmap: Each square is one hour of a weekday. The colour shows how fast you typed compared with your own usual pace; the stronger the colour, the more you typed in that hour.
tip.apps: Average speed and characters per program. You can give each one an alias by typing in its name.
tip.live: Compares your speed over the last 10 s with your usual good pace: 100% is the 90th percentile of your 10 s peaks over the last 30 days. You can go past it.
tip.burst: A burst is continuous typing. It ends when you stop for more than {pause} s, and bursts under 15 characters are discarded.
tip.longburst: Long burst: 10 seconds or more of typing without stopping. With {need} of them Tapomo knows your normal pace.
tip.pause: If you stop typing for longer than this, the burst ends and the pause is not counted in your speed.
tip.streak_today: Today your best streak is {n} characters without deleting!
tip.faster_than_usual: You're typing {p}% faster than usual today 🚀
tip.low_corrections: You only correct {p}% of what you type. Nicely done!
tip.near_record: Today's peak ({w} {u}) is just {d} {u} from your record
tip.record_today: You beat your speed record today: {w} {u}!
tip.best_hour: Your best hour is usually {h}:00. Make the most of it!
tip.volume_today: {n} characters so far today: about {pages} pages!
tip.calibrating: Keep typing: I'm learning your pace ({have}/{need})
tip.hello_empty: Hi! We haven't typed anything together yet today
tip.generic_1: Thinking pauses don't count: type at your own pace
tip.generic_2: If I get in the way, you can hide me from the tray
tip.generic_3: I never save what you type, I only count keys
gloss.title: Glossary
gloss.wpm.d: A "word" is 5 characters (spaces included), the international standard, so text with long words doesn't penalise you. It is the same speed as cpm, counted in words instead of characters.
gloss.cpm.d: Exactly the same as the keystrokes per minute (KPM) used by typing schools. Since a word is 5 characters, cpm = WPM × 5: 60 WPM is 300 cpm.
gloss.burst.d: Continuous typing without pauses longer than {pause} s. Bursts under 15 characters don't count.
gloss.peak.d: Your highest speed held for 10 seconds in a row.
gloss.streak.d: Characters in a row without pressing delete.
gloss.pace.d: Your usual good pace: the 90th percentile of your peaks over the last 30 days. You can beat it.
gloss.calibration.d: Tapomo needs {need} bursts of 10 s or more to learn your pace.
pet.hint: Click: say something · Double-click: open · Right-click: more
gloss.pet.d: Drag it to move it. Click: it tells you something. Double-click: opens this window. Right-click: menu (open, hide for an hour, hide, pause measuring).
pet.hide.fullscreen: I'm hiding while you watch something fullscreen
tip.volume_today_one: {n} characters so far today: about {pages} page!
version.label: Tapomo {v}
version.title: See what this version brings
settings.check_updates.hint: Only GitHub is asked whether there is a new version; nothing about your typing is sent.
update.title: There is a new version of Tapomo: {v}
update.text: Updating only takes a moment and your data stays as it is.
update.failed: Couldn't update right now. You can try again later.
settings.auto_update.hint: Tapomo installs new versions when you are not typing.
welcome.label: Welcome to Tapomo
welcome.1.title: Your privacy comes first
welcome.1.text: Tapomo only counts how many keys you press and when, never what you type. Password fields are ignored entirely and everything stays on your computer.
welcome.2.title: Getting to know your pace
welcome.2.text: The first 20 bursts help Tapomo learn your pace. From then on the bar is measured against yourself, not against anyone else.
welcome.3.title: Tapomo on your desktop
welcome.3.text: Tapomo keeps you company in a corner. Drag it wherever you like, click it to hear something nice, double-click to open this window and right-click for options. It hides by itself in fullscreen.
goal.title: Daily goal
goal.streak_start: Reach the goal today to start a streak
settings.goal.hint: Active minutes spent typing, pauses not counted. Reach it several days in a row and Tapomo celebrates with you.
settings.weekend_rest.hint: Saturday and Sunday aren't required: they never break the streak, and if you reach the goal they count anyway.
tip.goal: Active minutes are the real time spent typing (the sum of your bursts). One missed day a week doesn't break the streak: Tapomo uses a joker.
tip.goal_left_one: Only {n} min left to reach your goal
tip.goal_left: Only {n} min left to reach your goal
gloss.goal.d: The active minutes you want to type each day (10, 20 or 30). It counts the real time spent typing, the sum of your bursts, pauses excluded. It's a gentle target: everyone types at their own speed.
gloss.daystreak.d: Consecutive days reaching the goal. Every week (Monday to Sunday) you get one joker: a missed day doesn't break the streak and Tapomo spends it for you. With weekend rest on, Saturday and Sunday aren't required.
level.title: Level
level.aria: Level {lv}: {xp} of {next} XP to the next one
level.next_none: You have every reward! You can keep levelling up.
ch.title: Today's challenges
tip.challenges: Three challenges a day, tuned to your own average of the last two weeks. Each gives 15 XP, and all three together 15 more. Skipping them is fine: there are new ones tomorrow.
ch.long_bursts_one: Do one burst longer than 1 minute
ch.beat_avg: Beat your average pace ({wpm} wpm) in a burst of 20 s or more
ch.clean: Type {n} characters in a row without deleting
ch.full: Full house! All three: +15 bonus XP
wd.title: Tapomo's wardrobe
wd.hint: Every 3 levels you unlock a pack of two rewards. Tap one to put it on or take it off. If two things don't fit together, Tapomo takes off the one in the way.
wd.style.hint: Some rewards change with the style: subtle is more discreet.
lvup.title: Level {lv}!
lvup.retro.title: You start at level {lv}!
lvup.retro.text: Tapomo went through your history and turned it into XP.
gloss.xp.d: You earn XP by typing (up to 150 a day), meeting your goal, keeping your day streak, beating records and with today's challenges. XP is never lost. The first levels come fast and then space out: level 50 takes about a year of normal use.
gloss.challenges.d: Three new challenges every day, tuned to your average of the last two weeks. The ones you don't do simply disappear at midnight.
gloss.wardrobe.d: The rewards you unlock every 3 levels: skins, which change Tapomo's colour, and accessories and costumes it wears on top. You choose them in the wardrobe.
badges.title: Badges
tip.badges: You earn them with how you type and your habits. Each gives XP once: 25 for bronze, 50 for silver and 100 for gold.
badges.none: Your first badge comes with your first burst.
badges.retro.title_one: Tapomo found {n} badge in your history
badges.retro.title_other: Tapomo found {n} badges in your history
badges.retro.text: You had already earned them before they existed.
gloss.badges.d: Rewards for typing and habit milestones: your first bursts, runs without deleting, days in a row, records… Pending ones show as silhouettes with a hint. They are never lost.
badge.clean_1000.hint: Type 1,000 characters in a row without deleting
badge.clean_5000.hint: Type 5,000 characters in a row without deleting
badge.beating_5.hint: Reach the "Beating yourself!" zone in 5 bursts
badge.streak_7.hint: Meet your goal 7 days in a row
badge.streak_30.hint: Meet your goal 30 days in a row
badge.streak_100.hint: Meet your goal 100 days in a row
badge.goal_week.hint: Meet your goal every day of a week
badge.first_full.hint: Complete all three challenges of a day
badge.full_30.hint: Complete all three challenges on 30 days
badge.crowned.hint: Beat your best run without deleting and Tapomo puts on the crown
league.name: {league} league
league.first_week: You have {xp} XP this week. Your first week sets your pace: from Monday you compete with yourself.
league.to_go: You have {xp} XP this week. Reach {target} XP by Sunday to move up to {next}.
league.on_track: You have {xp} XP this week: you're already above your average! On Monday you move up to {next}.
league.top: You're in the top league! Here it's all fun: you never go down.
league.up.title: You moved up to {league}!
league.up.text: Last week you earned {xp} XP, more than your average of the weeks before.
league.stay.title: Good week! You stay in {league}
league.stay.text: Last week you earned {xp} XP. In the league with yourself you never go down: this week is another chance.
gloss.league.d: Every week (Monday to Sunday) your XP adds up. Beat the average of your previous 4 weeks and you move up a league: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond and Legendary Mochi. You never go down.
weekly.title: The best of your week
weekly.empty: Last week Tapomo rested with you. This week starts fresh!
weekly.typed_one: You typed on {n} day, {min} minutes in all
weekly.typed_other: You typed on {n} days, {min} minutes in all
weekly.goal_one: You met your goal on {n} day
weekly.goal_other: You met your goal on {n} days
weekly.peak_record: Record! Your best peak ever: {wpm} wpm
weekly.clean: Your best run without deleting: {n} characters
shortcuts.title: Shortcuts today
tip.shortcuts: Tapomo counts Ctrl, Alt or Windows combinations by kind. It never knows which one: each shortcut becomes its kind instantly and the key is thrown away. You can turn it off in Settings.
shortcuts.today_other: You've used {n} shortcuts today. Less mouse, more flow!
shortcuts.none: Try Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V: Tapomo counts them without ever knowing what you copy.
settings.count_shortcuts.hint: It only counts how many of each kind you use (copy & paste, undo, save, windows, other), never which one.
about.privacy_shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts are only counted by kind and by day; which shortcut it was is never stored.
gloss.shortcuts.d: Combinations with Ctrl, Alt or Windows, like Ctrl+C. Tapomo counts them by kind (copy & paste, undo, save, windows and other) and gives 1 XP per 10, up to 10 a day. It never stores which one it was.
tip.shortcuts_today: You've used {n} shortcuts today, you're really quick!
records.title: Your records
tip.records: Your best marks and when they happened. The text can't be shown because Tapomo never stores it, but the day, time, program and how long it lasted can. When you beat a record it arrives in a new envelope.
records.ctx_chars: On {date} at {time}, in {app}: {n} characters in a row
records.fun.peak: At that pace you'd type a whole tweet in {s} seconds.
records.fun.pages_one: Like a whole book page without a single slip.
records.fun.pages_other: Like {n} book pages without a single slip.
records.fun.tweets_one: Like a whole tweet without deleting anything.
records.fun.tweets_other: Like {n} tweets in a row without deleting anything.
records.fun.songs_one: Longer than a whole song without stopping.
records.fun.songs_other: Like {n} songs in a row without stopping.
records.fun.ads_one: Longer than a TV ad without stopping.
records.fun.ads_other: Like {n} TV ads in a row without stopping.
records.fun.day_other: About {n} book pages: a whole chapter!
gloss.records.d: Your best 10-second peak, your best run without deleting, your longest burst and your biggest typing day, with the day, time and program. Never the text.
lessons.title: Typing lessons
lessons.intro: Short lessons of a few minutes. You can never fail: each lesson gives one star for finishing it, two with 95% accuracy and three with 98% at your target pace.
lessons.real: Since you started the lessons, your real everyday speed went from {a} to {b} wpm.
lessons.run_hint: Type the text. A wrong letter is marked and Tapomo waits for the right one, no rush. Esc to leave.
lessons.tip.acc: Repeat for more stars: go a bit slower and aim for accuracy.
lessons.tip.pace: For the third star: the same accuracy at {target} wpm.
lessons.tip.new_best: Your best result in this lesson!
gloss.lessons.d: Short exercises to type without looking at the keyboard, row by row. In lessons the text is Tapomo's, so which keys you miss is stored, for lessons only. What you type every day is still never stored.
lessons.tip.caps: Tip: make capitals with the Shift of the other hand.
lessons.practice.title: Practise your tricky keys
lessons.practice.text: Tapomo noticed which keys are hardest for you in the lessons and made an exercise with them.
settings.lessons_in_goal: Lessons count towards the daily goal
album.title: Shortcut album
album.hint: Each shortcut levels up with the different days you use it: Learning, Getting the hang of it, Almost there and Mastered. It never goes down.
album.count_one: You already use {n} of {total} album shortcuts
album.count_other: You already use {n} of {total} album shortcuts
album.none: You haven't used any yet: the tip of the day will help you start!
pet.shortcut_learnt: You're using the shortcut I showed you!
badge.first_mastered.hint: Use the same shortcut on 11 different days
gloss.album.d: About 30 useful Windows, editing and browser shortcuts. Each levels up with the different days you use it (not how many times), so it can't be gamed. Tapomo only recognises album shortcuts; any other counts as "other" without knowing which.
